purpose: Brighter decoration palette studies on the user's approved workshop path arrangement

concepts.label: Turquoise + coral
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise edit of the attached Math Mews track screenshot. The user APPROVES this track layout. Preserve the entire UI exactly: canvas proportions, pale mint-to-ivory background, all four nodes with identical positions and sizes, numerals 4/5/6/7, green check badges, lock, lavender line with its broad rounded right-angle bends, berry active tile and ring, 'Continue here' label and arrow, navy 'Build a solution' text. Do NOT move nodes, change UI colors, add a header or footer, crop content, or introduce new text.
Change ONLY the two decorative groups and their local shadows. The upper cat-and-triangle construction is too large in this reference. Redesign the same coherent scene to about 280 pixels wide on this 726-pixel-wide canvas, centered in the open upper bend, entirely inside the line with comfortable clearance, larger than the tiny variant but smaller than this large reference. Retain a recognizable orange-and-cream cat with a readable expressive face, distinct ears and visible paws touching its geometric construction. The cat works with a triangular piece, thick wooden rods and two support blocks on a slim wooden base. Keep the same subject and purposeful action. Maintain natural orange cat coloring.
The lower gear pair remains in exactly its present location and size, now using the same vivid palette as the upper construction. Use three clearly coordinated painted colors plus a little natural pale wood. Maintain visible broad wood grain and restrained textile cues, clear rounded silhouettes, matte illustrative 2.5D craftsmanship. Colored paint should look like opaque matte painted wood, not shiny plastic. Short, light, footprint-specific shadows must touch the bases. No big dark haze, floating objects, noisy fuzz, photorealistic grain, sparkles, confetti, plants, extra toys or extra decoration groups. Preserve the selected pink level as the strongest attention cue. Output a refined single full screenshot, NOT a palette board or comparison sheet. Palette direction A: clean vivid turquoise #10B8BD as the main construction triangle and large gear, warm coral #F26C5C on the two supporting cubes and small gear, golden yellow #F5B932 for the gear centers and one wooden rod. Retain pale natural wood on the base and remaining rods. One restrained deep violet accent is allowed. These colors should look noticeably fresher and more saturated than the original muted sage and dusty lavender, while the background and all UI stay exactly unchanged.
